title: NRO Program B ground element at Pine Gap

tellings.quote: the ground element of NRO program B was established at Pineap Australia.

plain: In the 1980s, a secret branch of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, is said to have set up its ground station at Pine Gap, a remote listening base in the Australian outback. The researcher who goes by UAPGerb says this on the show: "the ground element of NRO program B was established at Pine Gap, Australia." He names a figure called R. Evans Heinman alongside the claim, and if it were true it would place this hidden unit's work on Australian soil.
